purpose: Descriptive current-F fixed-request owner scaling; not an optimization/adoption or2percent regression study
parent_role: Design, binding acceptance, one-window authorization and independent acceptance
dependencies: D018+D022 unchanged native harness/binaries and final W1 functional/diagnostic parent acceptance
native_build: Accepted original F timing binary only; no rebuild/new harness or diagnostic timing

schedule.prerun_scope: Whole fresh processes; environment pre-runs do not prewarm registry/Core inside subsequent child
schedule.block_rule: For b=0..5, rotate ABCDEF left by b, followed by exact reverse of that order

clock_boundary: Existing main clock/start barrier/end barrier/clock; includes synchronization/scheduling, pointer/count bookkeeping and corresponding library work. Excludes thread start, payload fill/verify, snapshots, join and output; registry process-lifetime bucket not destroyed by measured Core destroy.

statistics.anchor_drift: max(a_e)/min(a_e); implied by block dispersion but retained for explicit whole-window audit
statistics.cell_qualification: All AA/block_dispersion/anchor_drift<=1.10; else uncertain; keep all24condition-phase cells
statistics.comparison: r_b=g_case,b/g_C,b for b0..5; list all6 and median/min/max; qualified only if case and referenceC cells both qualified
statistics.interpretation: Ratios within10percent are direction unresolved; outside only describes this single window. Min/max is not confidence interval. No bootstrap, outlier removal or tail inference.

implementation_requirements: Use a small standalone collector/auditor and reuse accepted W1 exact semantic checker through immutable copied/reference identity; no generic framework or mutation of W1/W3 tools

Implement offline synthetic checks for schedule exactness, duplicate/missing/foreign samples, malformed/nonpositive times, qualification boundaries, wrong workload/build/approval and receipt integrity
Preserve each actual argv/exit/timeout/stdout/stderr plus all native reports; exact identity/semantic failure stops and preserves partial evidence
Current raw harness timing_evidence=false remains immutable: qualification is a separate externally approved measurement artifact, not a rewritten producer claim
Fresh run marker, independent parent approval SHA, exact frozen schedule/proposal/tools/Python identity; preparatory tests must not launch native benchmark
Archive a complete reviewable bundle with frozen collector/auditor, accepted producer linkage, raw reports and one relocation audit; do not replicate unrelated historical archives
Queue protects all actual timing and bulk archive work; W3 alone executes formal window after parent exact proposal acceptance
limits_of_inference: Owner count also changes per-owner requests, working set and Core metadata growth; fixed total requests does not isolate pure hash lookup complexity
Threads affect scheduling/barriers; R256 diagnosis cannot infer exact R8192 fractions or solely attribute delay to locks
No defaultD/F reopen, optimization implementation/adoption, production API or public-header edit
